The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6e7116ea33f29ee), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. statement: Suppose 4 < κ < 8. There exist C, c > 0 and L0 ≥ 2, depending only on κ, with the following property. Consider ordinary chordal SLE in H, possibly after a finite stopping time with a past already drawn, or a fixed similarity of such an evolution. Suppose B(z, r) is strictly inside the current surviving domain. Let τ be the subsequent first hit of ∂B(z, r). For L ≥ L0, on {τ < ∞, z ∈ Dτ }, set σ = inf{t ≥ τ : |γ(t) − z| ≥ Lr}, with value infinity if there is no such time. Then P{σ < ∞, z ∈ Dσ | Fτ } ≤ CL−c . The event in the display is an exit while the point is still live. The constants are independent of the past, the initial disk, and the exit time.
